Above and Beyond Alaska is Juneau’s premier wilderness guide service, offering unique wilderness adventures featuring glaciers, bears, and whales! Get a jump-start on your kayaking journey by boarding our 6-passenger boat and cruising through the Inside Passage to the richest humpback whale feeding ground in Alaska!
